name: ECC Campus Avatar Studio test precinct
purpose: The first complete, player-height review slice for the Career Empire campus rebuild.
visualTarget: ECC-informed Career Journey Campus: limestone, navy, timber, glass, native planting and restrained teal.

routes.design: pale limestone paving, planting on both edges, no vehicle road between plaza and entry

reviewChecks: The Avatar Studio entry is visible from the plaza connection.
The approach contains no more than eight seconds of empty walking.
The building, entrance, path and planting read together in one player-height camera frame.
No vehicle road separates the player from the studio entrance.
The teal portal is visible only once the player is near the entry.
